description: Department of Fiscal policy - Notification under the Finance Act, No. 35 of 2018 Luxury Tax on Motor Vehicles
categorisation: This gazette notification amends regulations under the Finance Act, No. 35 of 2018, specifically modifying luxury tax rates and classifications for motor vehicles. It constitutes a regulatory amendment to existing tax laws, falling clearly under Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5) as it involves statutory instruments and regulatory framework modifications. While it mentions a minister's name, it does not involve government personnel changes or structural reorganization, and the primary content is regulatory taxation matters.
